summary: Implemented SPEC-S3A CH1–CH7 without changing either protected source span. The hook now distinguishes a torn final JSONL record from interior corruption, detects suspected transcript staleness and re-polls, retains uncovered observations across polls, detects the seven bounded writer verbs, rejects receipts over the future-skew bound, applies component-safe per-target receipt coverage, and emits the specified normal/stale messages and header documentation. The stdlib-only suite now contains 78 passing tests; T3 compared 10,000 generated commands, T4 compared 48 static whole-hook scenarios plus two deterministic transcript swaps, and T6 met both performance budgets. TDD was followed for CH1–CH6: every production behavior change was preceded by a focused failing test, with RED and GREEN evidence below.
